name: Gimhae International Airport

runway.v: two runways; the longest, 18R/36L, is 3,200 m long and 60 m wide (18L/36R is 2,743 m)

curfew.v: no civil take-offs or landings from 23:00 to 06:00 local time (1400-2100 UTC)
curfew.quote: All civil aircraft take-off and landing are restricted from 1400 UTC to 2100 UTC,

hours.v: aerodrome operator 06:00 to 23:00 local time (2100-1400 UTC); air traffic services 24 hours; shared with a military air base

customs.v: customs and immigration as required by operations (HO)

fuel.v: Jet A-1 by hydrant, no time limitation stated
fuel.quote: No limitation at any time service available.

noise.v: idle reverse thrust only from 21:00 to 07:00 local time (1200-2200 UTC) after landing on runway 36L; NADP 1 departures; runway 36L preferred
noise.quote: Between 1200 UTC and 2200 UTC, pilots are requested to limit the use of reverse thrust to idle reverse

handling.v: handling as required by operations (HO) (no handling agents named)

notes: Read Korea eAIP AD 2 RKPK Gimhae INTL, package 24 Jul 2025 (latest package found by search; no effective date printed on the page). Joint civil and military airfield (ROKAF 5th Air Mobility Wing). AD 2.20 bans training flights and light sport / ultralight aircraft. No slot or PPR rule in the AIP page read. IATA code not printed on the page read.
